Input images: Images 1–3 are identity, costume, palette, painterly style, and gameplay-scale references for the approved ranger. Image 4 is ONLY a limb-spacing/rung-distance reference; do not render any ladder or copy ladder pixels.

Subject invariants: preserve the ranger's compact proportions, pointed dark-teal hood, masked/hidden identity, layered midnight-teal and jade outfit, dark leather armor and boots, cyan edge highlights, and warm amber short blade secured close to the belt/back so it cannot swing across cell boundaries. The face must be completely turned away and invisible in all four frames.
Style/medium: original hand-painted 2D fantasy game sprite/cutout matching the supplied ranger references; crisp readable silhouette and clean alpha
Composition/framing: exactly one row of four equal isolated cells; one full-body rear-facing ranger centered in every cell; identical body scale and anchor; hands raised in believable alternating rung grips and boots alternating in believable rung steps; generous clear gutters at every outer edge and between figures; no overlap; no separators
Lighting/mood: cool moonlit cyan rim light over deep teal/jade, tiny restrained amber blade accent
Constraints: actual transparent background; exactly four ranger figures; all strictly back-facing; climbing motion only; consistent hood/costume/body/weapon; no ladder, rung, rope, wall, platform, scenery, ground, shadow, panel, border, checkerboard, text, logo, watermark, or extra object
Avoid: side view, three-quarter face, visible eyes, front view, identity drift, extra limbs, detached weapon, pose duplication, camera changes, perspective, photorealism, 3D render, pixel art
